proves: A walker at 60 px/s has covered 300 px by the five-second mark, and not before.
html:
<script>
window.state = { x: 0, last: null, done: false };
function frame(ts) { if (state.last !== null) state.x += 60 * ((ts - state.last) / 1000); state.last = ts; if (state.x >= 300) state.done = true; requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
